name: @red-cup-engineering/read-hive-engine-account-history-service
description: Reads a Hive-Engine account's operation history, paged from two independent public REST indexers and witnessed against each other, over an optional time range; token transfers, staking, delegation, and distribution/curation entries are shaped directly, while market and pool-swap fills are resolved by transaction id through @red-cup-engineering/read-hive-engine-fill-service rather than re-derived.
